name: Mage
description: A data pipeline tool: build batch and streaming pipelines from Python, SQL and R blocks in a notebook-style editor, schedule them, and watch their runs. One container with the project, its SQLite metadata and the pipelines' code on the data volume.

access.note: Mage creates its owner from the environment on the first start: sign in with the e-mail chosen here and the generated DEFAULT_OWNER_PASSWORD from the Variables tab. It is applied only while no owner exists, so change the password inside Mage afterwards. Signed-in users can run code and open a terminal in the container, so invite only people you trust.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address the editor is opened at; nothing else here changes when it does.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The editor, the API and the run views

volumes.name: project
volumes.purpose: The project: pipelines' code, configuration and the SQLite metadata

update.notes: Mage migrates its metadata database on start; back up the project volume before moving to a newer image.

secrets.label: Session signing secret
